column1: # The items: a row per entry of the dictionary (gameplay/db_static_dictionaries items_dict), by dict_id.
# premium: a premium item (is_premium): sold one by one or in a bundle, never by a faction, and
# priced in silver as every item (gold is gone, 2026-11-08: its gold price times 100). like: the plain item a golden or premium copy is (srp_like);
# a copy has its plain item's level and defaults and no base rarity. start: the modifications of its
# own a new item comes with (srp_start), never one of its defaults. srp reads them from its game data.
